# bcgwcat2 - Groundwater Chemistry Analysis Tool

> Adapted from [bcgwcat](https://github.com/bcgov/bcgwcat) in light of
> the transition from EMS to EnMoDS. This may replace bcgwcat entirely
> in the future.

The goal of bcgwcat2 is to provide easy access to EnMods data as well as
to provide workflow tools specific to those working with groundwater.

> **Warning! This tool is a work in progress and is not ready for use.**

### Features

These tools are available through R functions as well as through a
**Shiny user-interface**. This tool can help with:

- Downloading EnMoDS data via the
  [renmods](http://github.com/bcgov/renmods) package
- Formatting data for easier use in R or other software (e.g., AquaChem)
- Calculating charge balances
- Calculating water types
- Providing water quality summaries
- Piperplots and Stiff plots

### Installation

Install/Update [**R**](https://cloud.r-project.org/) and
[**RStudio**](https://rstudio.com/)

Then install this R package:

``` r

# install.packages("pak", dependencies = TRUE) # If you don't already have pak installed
pak::pkg_install("bcgov/bcgwcat2") #"Update All" if asked
```

### Usage

- Launch the Shiny App -
  [`bcgwcat_app()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/bcgwcat_app.md)

#### Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

## basic example code
```

# Package index

## Shiny User-Interface

Function for launching the user-interface

## General function reference

Functions available for coding from the R console

- [`bcgwcat_app()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/bcgwcat_app.md)
  : Title
- [`charge_balance()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/charge_balance.md)
  : Calculate charge balance
- [`fetch_renmods()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/fetch_renmods.md)
  : Fetch renmods data for specific ems_ids
- [`fmt_minimal()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/fmt.md)
  [`fmt_wide()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/fmt.md) :
  Format EnMoDS data
- [`index_meta()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/index_meta.md)
  : Title
- [`index_meta_params()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/index_meta_params.md)
  : Title
- [`index_params()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/index_params.md)
  : Title
- [`meq()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/meq.md) :
  Calculate MEQ values
- [`meq_conversion()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/meq_conversion.md)
  : Title
- [`mod_data_ui()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/mod_data_ui.md)
  : Title
- [`mod_details_server()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/mod_details_server.md)
  : Title
- [`mod_details_ui()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/mod_details_ui.md)
  : Title
- [`mod_overview_ui()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/mod_overview_ui.md)
  : Title
- [`mod_plots_ui()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/mod_plots_ui.md)
  : Title
- [`mod_water_quality_ui()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/mod_water_quality_ui.md)
  : Title
- [`stiff_plot()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/stiff_plot.md)
  : Create Stiff plot
- [`tbl_overview()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/tbl_overview.md)
  : Reactable table for data overview
- [`tbl_water_quality()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/tbl_water_quality.md)
  : Reactable table for data overview
- [`water_quality()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/water_quality.md)
  : Assess problems with water quality
- [`water_type()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/water_type.md)
  : Calculate water type
- [`wq_std()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcgwcat2/reference/wq_std.md) :
  Water Quality Data
